newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia to sign new 32 mln Ecu PHARE agreement.
newsitem.headline: Estonia to sign new 32 mln Ecu PHARE agreement.

text.p: Estonia is set to sign an agreement on Tuesday with the European Union (EU) PHARE programme, which will provide it with a further 32 million Ecu ($37.7 million) of funds for various projects, the finance ministry said.
Finance Minister Mart Opmann and the head of the EU delegation will sign the agreement in Estonia, the ministry said in a statement.
The EU funds are allocated for a three-year period and will be used to further Estonia's integration with the EU, develop infrastructure and reorganise the state sector, the ministry said.
Some of the funds will also be used for teaching Estonian to the country's large Russian population and for social sector projects.
Since 1991, PHARE has allocated 95.7 million Ecu to Estonia, the finance ministry said.
-- Riga Newsroom, +371 721 5240 ($ = 0.849 European Currency Unit ECUs)
